# Signalsmith audio libraries

Vendored from the official repositories; no changes to upstream headers.

- Signalsmith Stretch 1.3.2: `a670068d9aeb64913331d5cc29337b19a457a7df`
  https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
- Signalsmith Linear: `146b26f91b48835d665fa0498d64d9617818d27a`
